units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 3. Code-design philosophy > What NOT to do

units.does: No behavioural claim: introduces the flow walkthroughs and points to FLOWCHART.md.

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.1 App launch & navigation
units.does: Claims launch: EmuquApp holds collector (RRCollector.makeDefault) + five sub-objects, syncManager, settingsManager, storeKitManager, languageManager, voiceChat, watchBridge, emailBridge as @State, all but collector taken from AppDependencies.current and each built through launchStep (log + signpost), and injects them via .environment; heavy setup deferred to boot() via runDeferredBoot(); no launch-hang timeout; launch gating via LaunchModal presented with fullScreenCover in loadDataAndContinue() in order disclaimer → onboarding → paywall → trial reminder → score-architecture change → else interrupted-session check; per-tab NavigationStack reset by MainTabView.resetPath(from:to:).

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.2 Overnight recording → recovery score → dashboard
units.does: Claims overnight spine: RRCollector.startOvernightStreaming arms H10 internal recording as backup (never on Verity Sense), ~60 s incremental raw-RR backup; StrapLinkCoordinator gives PolarReconnectPolicy.windowSeconds (20 min) before reconnectExhausted; Stop = RecordView.stopOvernightAndApplyOutcome -> RRCollector.stopOvernightStreaming -> OvernightStreamingCoordinator.stopOvernightStreaming (end arming, stop streaming infrastructure, back up beats, download/merge/score with bounded reconnect and parallel sleep poll, fallbackToDeviceFetch for a short stream), the download skipped by nightFetchAllowed when the night never armed the strap (overnightDeviceBackupActive false) and the strap reports no recording (isRecordingOnDevice false); gatherOvernightData named as the pause/recovery gather; DataSourceSelector.selectBestSource internal → composite (internal more than compositeThresholdPercent = 5% fewer beats) → streaming → raw backup, createComposite taking streamed beats in the internal series' gaps (findGaps: more than 2 s past the expected interval) or outside the span it recorded (uncoveredBeats); HRVAnalysisPipeline.analyzeWithAutoWindow runs WindowSelector.findBestWindow over 30-70% of sleep then analyzeWithWindow; computeRecoveryScore → calculateWithBreakdown 0-100 HRV60/Sleep25/Vitals15 stored 0-10 via toTenScale; archive + archiveSignal.notifyChanged + CloudKit upload; MainTabView.startDashboardLoad reloads recentSessionsAsync(limit: 35).

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.3 Workout recording → summary
units.does: Claims workout flow: WorkoutRecorder reconnects strap/Stryd/FTMS/PM5, starts GPS and barometric buffer only for a sport with usesGPS (startedLocation is nil for an indoor workout, so its location stack is never built); LiveDFAAnalyzer rolling α1 every 20 s; LiveWorkoutBroker snapshot; WorkoutTriggerEngine + WorkoutVoiceCoach, with WorkoutVoiceCoach.dispatch(event:) playing the alert haptic on the phone (CoachAlertHaptic.playOnPhone) and on the Watch (WatchConnectivityBridge.sendCoachAlertHaptic) and each spoken line claiming the cue session through CoachCueSpeech; WorkoutRecorder.stop ends an open pause at the stop date (pauseTimeline.resume); stopStreaming deferred until a 120 s HRR window (HRRCaptureService); finalizeSession runs WorkoutAnalyzer (TRIMP, hrTSS, power-TSS, splits, decoupling), elevation post-processing, archives and auto-archives a breadcrumb; after the archive write the workout goes to Apple Health via HealthKitWorkoutExport.export (replaces earlier exports of the session, active energy from netMETs = METs − 1 floored at 0) when HealthKit write is available; WorkoutPDFReport.generate produces the PDF. 20 s cadence is LiveDFAAnalyzer's cadenceSec default.

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.4 An AI turn (Flo)
units.does: Claims an AI turn: AssistantViewModel.send refuses empty input and Flo-off, answers a health-symptom question locally (medicalGuardRefused → MedicalQueryGuard), requires ProviderRegistry.canSend(to:) (isAvailable and switched on) for the active provider, then for a voice turn with no reply streaming tries the DeterministicIntent.tryMatch zero-token shortcut over 14 patterns before the consent check → dispatch(regenerating:) → resolveProviderForThisTurn (pure core TurnRouter) with RoutingMode active only while Apple is selected; Auto → CapabilityClassifier → SmartProviderRouter tier; TierProviderMapper mid tier Grok then DeepSeek else Apple; 50/day cap on deep turns; runToolUseLoop with CompactToolRouter.resolveTool and maxToolCallsPerTurn = 8; after a mutating tool a fallbackable failure becomes PickedModelFailure and is shown, not handed on; delete tools and writes of unstated values (memory add, contact add, set_address, route rename) return confirmation_required until the user's next message confirms (DestructiveActionContext.gateUnlessUserStated); CoachVoiceGuard.scrub passes MedicalQueryGuard's canned replies byte-identical; Apple path compacts at 70% of 4096, SessionCache reused only when AppleExchange.before matches the exchange it answered, rotates after 20 turns, 512-token replies; fact extraction only when mayExtractFacts (Flo allowed, canSend, consent); summaryBatch folds one budget-sized batch per send into the summary saved sealed by ConversationStore.saveSummary; Apple model prewarmed on the first send.

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 7. End-to-end flows > 7.5 Storage & iCloud sync
units.does: Claims storage/sync: SessionArchive.archive writes JSON to the App Group, stores SHA-256, updates the locked index, persists it; CloudKitSyncManager.uploadSession only when cloudUploadsAllowed (sync on, onboarding done, not PurgeGate.isPurging, re-checked inside the serializer with CloudAccountGuard.confirmAccount) strips Health-sourced fields via CloudSessionPayload.uploadable then ZLIB-compresses and encrypts into a private-DB CKAsset; sample nights never built into a record (CloudUploadExclusion.sampleData); performFullSync on launch/foreground, re-checking sync-on and !isPurging inside its serializer turn; soft-delete isDeleted and deletedSessionIds; the recorded account (CloudAccountIdentity, UserDefaults) gates every read/write and key creation until confirmed this launch; verdict adopts the signed-in account when none is recorded; when the account changed this launch with bookkeeping left (attributeBookkeeping), lookUpBookkeeping fetches a few uploaded session ids from the signed-in account: one found adopts, none found → different account, an iCloud error decides nothing; a different account or zoneWasDeleted → stopSync (forget account, reset bookkeeping, sync off, notice; local data kept; no zone recreated); Delete All My Data closes PurgeGate (archive writes refused via admitWrite, uploads/full sync skipped, waits for in-flight writes) and sets iCloudSyncEnabled false before the remote delete; runDeferredMigrations runs one-time migrations in the background.

units.key: § Emuqu — Maintainer's Guide > 10. Build, test, CI & tooling > The code map
units.does: Describes docs/codemap/records (a record per Swift function, initializer, computed property, protocol requirement, script function, Makefile target, workflow step and Markdown section, with what it does, triggers, calls, shared state and branches); the call graph (recorded calls plus calls, property reads, protocol dispatch and closure assignments found in the code); make codemap-impact (what a change can break, nearest first: the test suites to run as xcodebuild -only-testing arguments, callers and what each relies on, alike code elsewhere that may need the same change, shared state and its other users, then the entry points and docs; the same list in the gates.yml PR job summary); scripts/codemap/measure.py, which checks impact against the history (of the units commits changed together, how many it would have named); the persistent index in build/codemap-index.sqlite (scripts/codemap/index.py) the commands read, which re-reads only the files and records that changed, and index.py --verify, which checks it against a build from scratch; and make codemap-guard (in make ci, both workflows and the pre-commit hook) failing on a missing or empty record, code changed since stamping, a re-check line (callee now describes different behaviour, or a new certain callee) until it is re-read and stamped or acknowledged, a record naming a unit that no longer exists, or a record citing a line number; codemap.py status lists every problem. States that tests are not sent back (running them checks them); that a caller is checked against what a callee returns and writes (`does` or its `contract`, `entry`, `writes`), not what it reads; that records list only their own code's state (impact shows the whole reach); and that a wrapper names what it runs in `delegates`, so its callers are checked against that instead. Gives the change procedure (impact, change with codemap.py move for a moved file or renamed unit, rewrite, re-check via status --by-callee with ack for an unaffected caller, stamp in one pass once callees' records are written) and says a record with a contract sends its callers back only when the contract changes, with links to codemap/README.md, and states the limits: the guard proves timing, not correctness; without a type checker ambiguous names are possible callers and only certain edges trigger re-checks. Every claim matches codemap.py, graph.py and the workflows.
